records.scope: Actual own medium actor skill-session start/finish; all construction, failed compiles, repairs, final direct source compile and kernel checks included. Pre-start contract/setup inspection excluded; post-finish immutable evidence archive and cost administration excluded. Shared cost evidence referenced once.

measurement_details.method: 10ms requested /proc process-tree RSS sampling; GNU time max RSS per command
measurement_details.scope: Launched tool processes plus time launcher; excludes model-serving/desktop agent memory
measurement_details.limitations: RSS sum may count shared pages more than once; sampling may miss brief peaks. GNU max RSS is an individual-process maximum, not summed concurrent memory.
measurement_details.aggregation: max over sequential tools/children; overlapping child runs have no combined peak estimate
